derived_from: SKILL.md steps 8-9 and references/output-templates.md Templates A/B/C. Kept as DATA so that when the prescribed shape changes this file is the single place to update.
why_task_specific: v1.1 applied ONE marker set to every task and wrongly failed the Slack case: Template C explicitly forbids markdown tables and forbids naming reference files inside the message ('no process narration at all in a Slack message'). Requiring a gate table there penalised the skill for following its own template. Format conformance is per-template or it is nothing.

required_markers.name: verdict_on_first_line
required_markers.why: SKILL.md: 'Verdict is the first line.' Positional, so a verdict after a preamble fails.

required_markers.name: all_three_gates_with_status
required_markers.why: All three validity gates appear with status, even when an earlier one already failed.

required_markers.name: gate_status_tokens
required_markers.why: A gate table needs statuses, not prose. Loose on purpose: the check is that statuses exist, not that markdown was used.

required_markers.name: references_cited_by_path
required_markers.why: SKILL.md self-check: references cited by path. Required for Templates A and B, NOT for C.

suppressed_only_markers.name: suppression_stated_explicitly
suppressed_only_markers.why: Silently omitting the lift is weaker than naming the suppression: a reader must be able to tell refusal from oversight.

required_markers.name: n_per_arm_stated
required_markers.why: Template B leads with n per arm.

required_markers.name: enrolment_and_maturation_separated
required_markers.why: THE method signal for this task: total = enrolment + the metric's own window. An answer giving only enrolment days is wrong even when n is right.

required_markers.name: total_duration_stated
required_markers.why: Template B ends in a TOTAL line.

required_markers.name: references_cited_by_path
required_markers.why: Template B has an explicit 'Process & references' block.

suppressed_only_markers.name: sizing_flagged_as_floor
suppressed_only_markers.why: output-templates.md: 'If the current data failed maturity, say plainly that the sizing is a floor' -- the sd came from an immature column.

required_markers.name: bottom_line_first_sentence
required_markers.why: Template C: 'The first sentence is the bottom line -- the same rule as line 1 of a readout.' No warm-up, no header line above it.

required_markers.name: mechanism_named_in_prose
required_markers.why: Template C wants reasons as plain sentences with the MECHANISM first -- not a gate table, which it forbids.

required_markers.name: next_step_given
required_markers.why: Template C: 'What we do next: the fix, the rerun size and duration.'

suppressed_only_markers.name: explains_why_no_number
patterns: won'?t send|not sending|no number|not going to (?:give|send|quote)
suppressed_only_markers.why: Template C has a dedicated beat: 'Why I'm not sending a lift number.' Declining silently is weaker than saying why.

forbidden_markers.name: no_process_narration
forbidden_markers.why: Template C: 'No process narration at all in a Slack message: nobody in the channel needs to know which reference file you read.' NOTE: only applied to the message body; an agent's wrapper commentary to the analyst is not part of the draft.
